newsitem.title: UK: OPTIONS-FTSE Nov strangles bet on index volatility.
newsitem.headline: OPTIONS-FTSE Nov strangles bet on index volatility.

text.p: Options traders were betting on an increase volatility in the FTSE 100 index before November expiry, dealers said.
They noted that some 2,000 strangles traded in the November 3950 calls and November 4000 puts.
"If you think the market is going to move on the tomorrow's (U.S. employment) numbers or on the (U.S.) election, or sometime before expiry, then it's probably a good trade," said one dealer.
November index options expire on November 20.
At 1342 GMT, the FTSE 100 was down 2.6 points at 3,961.3.
On Friday afternoon, the potentially market moving U.S. employment data for October will be published.
Elsewhere, dealers noted the straight purchase of some 2,000 April 750 calls and another 2,000 April 800 calls on British Petroleum.
The shares were up 3-1/2p at 660-1/2p, after setting a two-month low yesterday.
Dealers noted 400 lots that traded in January 1100 calls on Shell Transport some 250 lots in July 420 puts on Cable & Wireless.
Shares in Shell were off 9p at 1011-1/2p, after the oil group posted weaker-than-expected third quarter profits.
Shares in Cable & Wireless were up 1-1/2p to 485-1/2p.
